narrative.details:
There are rumors of a Twilight's Hammer member called Ortell having deserted his sect.  Word has it he hid in the mountains south of Southwind Village, where he lives as a hermit.  Perhaps you can enlist his help in deciphering the tablet.

Take the restored tablet with you and seek out Ortell.
narrative.objectives: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I see you're familiar with my old organization.  You must be with Cenarion Hold.

You seek information to use against them?  Come closer, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.
narrative.requestItemsText: You!  How did you find me?  Who are you?  You weren't followed, were you?  Speak!

quests.name: The Twilight Mystery
quests.objectiveText: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.

quests.name: The Deserter
quests.objectiveText: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: The Twilight Lexicon
quests.objectiveText: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: True Believers
quests.objectiveText: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts

quests.name: A Terrible Purpose
quests.objectiveText: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
